brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Pieces at q0,0 and q1,0 stacked on two levels (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full with snap:0,0,0;full, and piece:1,0,0;full + piece:1,0,1;full with snap:1,0,0;full). Connectors and jointBolts tie the two columns together at both levels; covers close the top (cover:0,0,1;full;top, cover:1,0,1;full;top).

requirements.requirement: At least two drawers for storage
requirements.evidence: Two notch drawer frames installed in the bay between the columns: notch:0#0,1#notch1 at level 0 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) and notch:1#0,1#notch1 at level 1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm), giving one drawer per storey.
2-cell footprint (q0,0 + q1,0) ~381mm x 169mm, 160mm tall (2x80mm), with all open faces capped (16 caps) and meshClash clear per check_build.

finish.summary: Built a two-storey tower (2 columns x 2 levels, 4 full bases with snaps) joined by side connectors/joint bolts, topped with covers and capped edges. Added two notch drawer frames (level 0 and level 1 at q0,1) to provide two drawers. check_build ok, meshClash clear.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
